## The Marriott Vacation Clubs® and Topeka Collaborate to Launch Moon Crush “Sunshine Live,” a New Destination Music Weekend


*Zac Brown Band and Lady A to Headline Two-Night Destination Music Weekend April 23–24, 2027, in Orlando, Florida, with Unique Access for Owners Across The Marriott Vacation Clubs Portfolio*


**ORLANDO, Fla., October 22, 2026 —** The Marriott Vacation Clubs, a portfolio of premium vacation ownership brands operated by Marriott Vacations Worldwide, and Topeka, creator of premium destination music vacations, today announced a new collaboration bringing together world-class live music and exceptional resort experiences.


The collaboration will launch April 23–24, 2027, with Moon Crush “Sunshine Live” presented by The Marriott Vacation Clubs, an intimate two-night music getaway at Grande Lakes Orlando, a premier luxury resort destination featuring Marriott’s Lakeshore Reserve, The Ritz-Carlton Orlando, Grande Lakes and JW Marriott Orlando, Grande Lakes.


Multi-platinum, three-time GRAMMY Award-winner, Zac Brown Band, and multi-platinum, seven-time GRAMMY Award winner, Lady A, will headline the inaugural weekend, joined by Colbie Caillat, Drake White, The Castellows and Nashville Yacht Club Band.


Intimately designed for just 4,000 guests, Sunshine Live will transform a green space adjacent to Marriott’s Lakeshore Reserve into a purpose-built open-air music venue featuring Topeka’s signature reserved Cove seating and hospitality. The experience is designed around a simple idea: no lines, no bad seats and no stress – just great music with the people you came to enjoy it with.


Guests can make an entire vacation out of the weekend, spending their days enjoying award-winning accommodations, exceptional dining, championship golf, a world-class spa and expansive pool experiences before walking to the concerts each evening.


At the heart of the music experience areTopeka’s signature Coves– reserved, semi-private spaces that give each group its own home base for the shows. Guests can sit together, come and go without losing their spot, and order food and drinks from their phones for delivery directly to their Cove in minutes. Even the restrooms are air-conditioned.


Owners across The Marriott Vacation Clubs portfolio, including Marriott Vacation Club, Sheraton Vacation Club and Westin Vacation Club, will receive special early access to ticket packages and experiences as part of their ownership. Sunshine Live builds on the recent launch of Inner Circle, The Marriott Vacation Clubs’ owner experiences platform, which connects Owners with special access, benefits and experiences beyond the resort stay.


“Live music has an incredible ability to bring people together, and that fits naturally with the way people think about their most memorable vacations,” said Mike Flaskey, President and Chief Operating Officer of Marriott Vacations Worldwide. “This collaboration gives us an opportunity to create something guests can plan an entire weekend around: great artists, a remarkable Orlando setting and meaningful time with the family and friends who matter most.”


“Moon Crush is a new category of music festival where guests can enjoy world class artist performances in an intimate no line environment where everyone is a VIP,” said Andy Levine, CEO of Topeka. “Guests can spend the day enjoying the resort amenities available across the Grande Lakes Orlando campus and then enjoy a short walk to the venue where your reserved space is already waiting for you. Order food and drinks from your phone, and we bring it to you, so you don’t have to miss a moment of music or connection with your favorite people. That’s Live Music Made Easy.”


Debuting with the Sunshine Live launch, Private Sunset Suites will offer a new reserved seating option for corporate and group entertainment. Designed for up to 10 guests, Private Sunset Suites will allow companies to host clients, reward employees or entertain partners. Private Sunset Suites will also be available for families and larger groups looking to experience the weekend together.


For The Marriott Vacation Clubs Owners, visit the[Sunshine Live Music Experience page](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finnercircle.marriottvacationclubs.com%2Fsunshine-live-music-experience%2F&esheet=54625860&newsitemid=20261020585568&lan=en-US&anchor=Sunshine+Live+Music+Experience+page&index=1&md5=141b0e14923e9bfaadb0136191ecc0b5) for information on how to book tickets and special access packages.


For information on general admission tickets and resort packages, visit[https://mooncrushsunshinelive.com/](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fmooncrushsunshinelive.com%2F&esheet=54625860&newsitemid=20261020585568&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fmooncrushsunshinelive.com%2F&index=2&md5=6d901c2a56161801d11b8dce5597e156) .


**EVENT DETAILS**


**Moon Crush “Sunshine Live” presented by The Marriott Vacation Clubs** **April 23–24, 2027** **Grande Lakes Orlando — Orlando, Florida** **Headliners:** Zac Brown Band and Lady A plus Colbie Caillat, Drake White, The Castellows and Nashville Yacht Club Band
**Capacity:** Only 4,000 guests
**Experience:** Reserved Coves, Sunshine Suites, Sunshine Bay, and Hospitality Deck; premium food and beverage delivery; resort amenities; and walkable concerts
**Private Sunset Suites:** Available for corporate, group and family hospitality
**General Pre-Sale Begins:** October 29, 2026
**Feel the Sunshine. Live the Moment.**


**ABOUT TOPEKA**


Topeka creates premium U.S.-based destination music vacations designed to make live music easier and more enjoyable. Topeka Music Weekends combine world-class artists with reserved Cove seating, walkable accommodations and hospitality-focused service so guests can spend less time waiting and more time connecting with the music and the people they came with.


Built around its “Live Music Made Easy” philosophy, Topeka creates intimate environments where fans can experience their favorite artists while enjoying the comfort, convenience and shared moments of a true vacation.


Experience the feel of a Topeka Music Weekend here[https://vimeo.com/1047212043](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fvimeo.com%2F1047212043&esheet=54625860&newsitemid=20261020585568&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fvimeo.com%2F1047212043&index=3&md5=90f6bcd04911f9d709e7383ee03f7826) and at[www.topeka.live](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.topeka.live&esheet=54625860&newsitemid=20261020585568&lan=en-US&anchor=www.topeka.live&index=4&md5=e8f9b80281a29a10f90c3603d705edde) .


**About The Marriott Vacation Clubs®**


The Marriott Vacation Clubs® is a part of Marriott Vacations Worldwide Corporation (NYSE: VAC) and is a portfolio of industry leading vacation ownership brands with over 90 properties collectively throughout the U.S., Caribbean, Mexico, Central America, Europe, Asia, and Australia, including the Marriott Vacation Club®, Sheraton® Vacation Club, and Westin® Vacation Club brands. Owners, Members and guests can enjoy year-round access to some of the best vacation destinations with villa-style accommodations. The Marriott Vacation Clubs’ point-based vacation ownership programs provide Owners, Members, and their families with the flexibility to enjoy high-quality vacation experiences.
